baseline_models.focus_anchor: وقال نسوة في المدينة ... إنا لنراها في ضلال مبين
baseline_models.mechanism: A group inside the city converts reported private conduct into a collective verdict. The shift from circulating speech to emphatic first-person-plural seeing makes social opinion present itself as direct, manifest knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Speech circulating among people makes the opening utterance a rumor channel and gives the verdict public reach.
The female collective supplies a plural social witness rather than one private observer.
The gathered city supplies the civic field through which household information becomes communal knowledge.
Seeing as considered opinion lets the emphatic claim function as judgment as well as visual report.
Deviation from a right course supplies the norm against which the women place her conduct.
Manifest disclosure turns the group's evaluation into something they claim is already exposed and settled.

changed_reading.before: Several women remark that the official's wife is plainly misguided by love.
changed_reading.after: An urban speech collective turns a household desire into a public case and presents its shared opinion as self-evident sight.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: امرأت العزيز تراود فتاها عن نفسه
baseline_models.mechanism: The title of power, the possessive dependent, iterative solicitation, and the directional phrase away from his self form an asymmetric contest over agency. The action is not merely an invitation toward an act; it repeatedly works to detach the youth's decision from the youth himself.

activation_trace.role: Dominance and prevailing power in the title load the household relation with an asymmetry capable of enforcing desire.
Solicitation as a contest with another's will makes persuasion itself the central struggle.
Back-and-forth movement makes the present-tense pursuit iterative pressure rather than a single proposal.
The split mapping's image of diverting or pushing away activates the directional force of taking him away from self-command.
The servant or owned-dependent sense makes the possessive label socially consequential rather than merely affectionate.
Self as the very identity of a thing makes personal agency, not only the requested act, the object at risk.

changed_reading.before: She repeatedly tries to seduce her young servant.
changed_reading.after: A powerful household figure repeatedly contests a dependent youth's will, attempting to draw his very self-command away from him.

baseline_models.mechanism: The clause places her as the one penetrated or enveloped by love while the surrounding speech places her under public inspection. Heart membrane, inner core, appearance, and manifestation create a path from inward occupation to outward legibility.

activation_trace.role: Love reaching the heart's covering gives the affect a spatial path into a protected interior.
The heart's innermost kernel deepens that path from surface covering toward a central attachment.
The inward faculty of reason and feeling keeps the mechanism attached to contested interior governance.
Visible appearance supplies the exterior surface on which the women think inward capture can be read.
Disclosure completes the movement from a hidden heart-bound state to a publicly asserted sign.

changed_reading.before: Her love for him is very intense and obvious.
changed_reading.after: The verse spatializes love as an occupation crossing into the heart while urban observers claim that this interior event has become readable on her exterior.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence first treats Joseph as concealed merchandise, cheapens his value, and transfers him into a household; it then explicitly marks attained maturity, strength, and sound judgment. Against that sequence, her youth or servant is a status label imposed on a mature subject, and away from his self becomes a further attempted appropriation of what the transaction did not own.

activation_trace.role: A cut-off portion of wealth becoming merchandise supplies the initial conversion of the person into tradable property.
Exchange through sale places the youth inside an actual transfer rather than a merely figurative dependency.
Diminution of right and value marks the transaction as a prior social devaluation of the person acquired.
Taking as acquisition supplies the household's proposed incorporation of him as a lasting relation.
Arrival at a limit establishes that the dependent named in the focus has reached mature capacity.
Attainment of full strength blocks a reading of the focus label as simple childish incapacity.
Sound judgment supplies an already formed moral agency that solicitation must contest rather than create.
The dependent-servant branch lets the possessive expression retain the history of transfer inside the focus wording.
Identity itself names the residue of personhood that purchase and household status have not legitimately absorbed.

structural_cues: 12:19-21 moves him from concealed merchandise through a cheap sale into the purchaser's household and a proposed filial role.
12:22 gives the same person maturity, strength, judgment, and knowledge before 12:30 calls him her youth or servant.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a transaction-to-household sequence, mature competence, and the focus possessive; I infer that this history makes the solicitation another attempted appropriation of self-direction. A live alternative is that the focus label marks youth or household service without specifying a precise legal ownership status.

changed_reading.before: Her servant status gives her access to a young man whom she desires.
changed_reading.after: The city reduces a purchased yet mature moral subject to her dependent, while the phrase away from his self exposes the unowned agency her pressure seeks to capture.

context_deltas.mechanism: A closed interior encounter generates proofs and a rear-oriented material trace, is adjudicated through a witnessing sign, and is then met with instructions to turn away and cover the fault. The next move into women speaking in the city reads as the public afterlife of evidence that could not remain enclosed.

activation_trace.role: Firm closure makes the encounter an intentionally sealed household event whose later circulation needs a boundary crossing.
The doors as entries define the threshold between private action and information reaching the city.
Demonstrative proof introduces an evidentiary register distinct from the women's later collective assertion.
A lengthwise tear turns the attempted encounter into a durable material trace.
The rear direction gives that trace inferential force about pursuit and flight.
A sign that bears witness converts the damaged object into adjudicative evidence.
Turning aside supplies the instruction to drop or withdraw from the exposed affair.
Protective covering supplies the attempted containment of fault immediately before the city speaks.
Circulating speech is the mechanism by which the supposedly closed case acquires a public life.
The city collective enlarges a household adjudication into a civic reputation.

structural_cues: 12:23 seals the encounter behind repeatedly closed doors.
12:25-28 lets a rear-torn shirt carry the event into material adjudication.
12:29 orders Joseph to turn away and the wife to seek covering; 12:30 immediately relocates the matter into city speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enclosure, material evidence, adjudication, attempted covering, and subsequent public speech; I infer a leak-and-suppression pathway from house to city. The women could instead have learned independently, and the instruction to turn away may mean only to drop the matter rather than organize a cover-up.

changed_reading.before: The women exchange free-floating gossip about a private scandal.
changed_reading.after: Their speech is the civic afterlife of a sealed but materially evidenced case whose attempted closure failed to contain its reputation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus group's confident we see is followed by the wife hearing their speech, preparing an encounter, and making direct sight possible. That sight magnifies Joseph in their inward estimation, disrupts their bodies, and drives a category jump from human to angelic; the accusers' earlier optical certainty is therefore exposed as untested and unstable.

activation_trace.role: Public notoriety reaching the ear closes the feedback loop from city speech to the wife's response.
Sending for the women turns dispersed talkers into an assembled audience.
Something made present and ready marks the encounter as staged infrastructure for a test of their judgment.
Immediate sensory sight replaces the focus verse's socially mediated claim to seeing.
Inward magnification records direct perception changing their valuation rather than merely confirming prior opinion.
Physical severing makes the altered gaze bodily and costly, undermining detached moral judgment.
The visible-skinned human category supplies the ordinary classification that their response denies.
The angel category supplies the hyperbolic reclassification produced by direct encounter.
Seeing as opinion identifies the earlier emphatic verdict as the position later put under experiential pressure.

structural_cues: 12:31 begins when the wife hears of the women's scheming speech and deliberately gathers them.
She orders Joseph to emerge; their first direct sight is followed by cut hands and a human-to-angel reclassification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the heard accusation, staged appearance, bodily disruption, and revised classification; I infer that the wife uses exposure to reveal the accusers' epistemic fragility. A live alternative is that she seeks self-justification rather than conducting a deliberate test of their way of seeing.

changed_reading.before: The women plainly see a uniquely deluded woman from a position of sober distance.
changed_reading.after: Their emphatic we see is a pre-encounter verdict that direct sight will reverse, implicating their own bodies and making their certainty self-undermining.

context_deltas.mechanism: The wife later names the same solicitation and self construction, acknowledges his active resistance, then backs her demand with command, confinement, and humiliation. This reveals a coercive continuum latent in the focus present tense: persuasion contests his will, and refusal activates institutional force.

activation_trace.role: The repeated solicitation branch confirms that the contest with another's will is the act she publicly admits.
The repeated self construction keeps identity and self-command, not only sexual access, at the center of the contest.
Protective self-restraint gives him active resistance and marks the boundary her pressure fails to cross.
An obligatory demand exposes the movement from solicitation into overt command.
Confinement supplies the institutional sanction attached to continued refusal.
Humiliation supplies a social penalty alongside physical confinement.
Iterative back-and-forth in the focus verb becomes the earlier phase of the later escalation.

structural_cues: 12:32 repeats the focus wording for solicitation away from his self and states that he resisted.
The same speech conditions prison and abasement on failure to do what she commands.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a lexical reprise, acknowledged resistance, command, and sanctions; I infer that the focus present tense compresses a persistent coercive process rather than courtship alone. The threat is a later escalation, so its full force need not have been present at the first approach.

changed_reading.before: Persistent seduction becomes coercive only after she is frustrated.
changed_reading.after: The focus solicitation already contests agency inside a power relation whose later command, prison, and humiliation reveal the force available behind persuasion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus depicts her as deeply occupied by love; Joseph later calls prison more beloved, admits that invitation could incline his heart, asks for diversion, and receives it. The recurrence separates two coexisting modes of desire: capture that seeks to possess another, and acknowledged susceptibility that can rank, refuse, and redirect itself through a costly preference.

activation_trace.role: Abiding love supplies the comparative preference by which prison is chosen over compliance.
A call that draws by speech makes the women's invitation an active vector on desire.
Turning something away supplies the requested redirection of that vector rather than denial of vulnerability.
The heart's youthful inclination names a live susceptibility that Joseph himself acknowledges.
The split mapping's image of a heart pouring toward passion intensifies the possible directional slide toward them.
Disordered lightness of temperament supplies the state into which unredirected inclination could carry him.
An answering response supplies the enabling event that makes requested redirection effective.
The actual turning away completes the trajectory from admitted attraction to preserved action.
Love reaching the heart's covering supplies the contrasting focus image of desire already lodged deep within her.

structural_cues: 12:33 juxtaposes prison as more beloved with the possibility of inclining toward the women's call.
12:33-34 moves from requested diversion to an answered diversion of their scheme.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated love language, comparative preference, admitted inclination, petition, and response; I infer a contrast between captured desire and desire that is ranked and redirected. A live alternative is that more beloved is ordinary preference language and does not by itself propose a general account of desire.

changed_reading.before: Her excessive love contrasts with Joseph's lack of desire.
changed_reading.after: Her inward capture contrasts with Joseph's admitted susceptibility and costly reordering of desire; the opposition is not feeling versus no feeling, but possession versus redirected agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: After signs have been seen, a new course appears to the decision-makers and imprisonment still follows. This later sequence breaks any automatic link between seeing what is manifest and acting in accord with it, so the focus women's we see can carry performative certainty without guaranteeing reliable knowledge or just action.

activation_trace.role: The appearance of a new opinion marks decision as something that emerges after evidence rather than being compelled by it.
Actual perception establishes that the signs entered the decision-makers' field of sight.
A manifest sign supplies visible evidence whose force can nevertheless be overridden.
Confinement supplies the action that follows sight without transparently following its truth.
Seeing as opinion lets the women's emphatic claim participate in the episode's unstable relation between perception and judgment.
Claimed manifestness is the certainty that the later seen-yet-disregarded signs place under pressure.

structural_cues: 12:35 explicitly places the decision to imprison after the signs had been seen.
The focus and 12:35 both couple seeing language with a socially consequential judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seen signs followed by confinement; I infer that the episode distinguishes visibility from truth-conforming action and rereads the focus certainty accordingly. The agents of they in 12:35 need not be identical to the women, so the activation is an optical parallel across the episode, not a claim that the same group made both decisions.

changed_reading.before: We see her means that her error is objectively obvious to competent observers.
changed_reading.after: We see her performs communal certainty in a narrative where even seen signs do not ensure sound judgment or action.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a form-distant immobilization branch of love and links it to the later prison threat. It remains anchored in love reaching her heart and explicit confinement, but downstream prose should present it only as an ironic material analogy, not as the lexical meaning of love here or a clinical causal diagnosis.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قد شغفها حبا, read beside the later threat to imprison him

activation_trace.role: Penetration to the heart's covering locates her constraint inside the affective body.
The distant image of an animal made to stay from incapacity activates love as inward immobilization.
Literal confinement supplies the outward sanction into which the inward image can be projected.

changed_reading.before: Love overwhelms her, and separately she threatens to imprison him.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, her inward immobilization by desire is externalized as an attempt to immobilize the person who will not yield.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain reading built from merchandise as a severed portion, devaluation, torn cloth, cut hands, and the focus phrase away from his self. The recurring partition is visibly anchored but branch-distant; render it as a material analogy for alienation, never as a claim that the focus words literally mean cutting or that every cut has one intended symbolism.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فتاها عن نفسه, where a possessive status is followed by motion away from self

activation_trace.role: A portion cut from a whole gives the merchandise label a latent image of partition.
The tradable portion converts that partition into a social treatment of the person as property.
Reduction of right and worth makes the partition a devaluation of personhood as well as material division.
The lengthwise tear transfers the partition image from traded status to the garment that records resistance.
The women's bodily cutting extends the same material image into the accusers' own embodied response.
Diversion away supplies the focus motion by which another partition of person from self is attempted.
The dependent-servant status anchors the material network in an unequal social relation.
Self as identity names the whole whose integrity the recurring divisions place at issue.

changed_reading.before: A servant is pressured to surrender to his mistress.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, solicitation continues an episode-wide logic of partitioning a person into commodity, status, garment, and body, while away from his self names the threatened alienation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The reading is surprising because it yokes hiddenness and loss to manifestation inside the compact phrase clear error. It remains anchored in the explicit seeing claim and adjacent roots, but downstream prose should retain the ordinary moral sense and offer this only as a paradoxical spatial rendering of being publicly visible as inwardly lost.

activation_trace.role: Perception establishes the group's claim that her condition lies openly within their sight.
Hiddenness supplies the paradoxical interior condition that their gaze claims to expose.
Loss supplies a spatial sense of being missing from a right relation or from self-possession.
Manifest disclosure makes that inward absence publicly legible rather than privately concealed.

changed_reading.before: She is in obvious moral error.
changed_reading.after: She is paradoxically visible to the city as inwardly lost: an exposed absence from right relation and self-command.

strongest_changes: The purchase history and subsequent maturity turn her youth or servant into a status reduction of a competent subject and sharpen away from his self as attempted appropriation of agency.
Closed doors, material evidence, and attempted covering make the women's city speech the public afterlife of a household case rather than contextless gossip.
The staged encounter reverses the accusers' claimed sight: direct seeing alters their valuation, wounds their bodies, and destabilizes their human classification.
The later admission, command, prison, and humiliation reveal a coercive continuum already latent in repeated solicitation.
The recurrence of love, inclination, turning, and response permits a contrast between desire that captures and desire that is acknowledged, ranked, and redirected.
summary.what_was_special: The trace preserved split-root activations for diversion, bodily inclination, and dependent status; it also followed seeing across opinion, proof, direct encounter, manifest signs, and disregarded evidence. These branches support concurrent social, coercive, optical, affective, and material readings without collapsing them into one verdict.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet sharpens dependency but does not by itself settle the exact legal status denoted by the focus possessive.
The household-to-city leak is abductively strong but the women could have learned through an unshown independent channel.
The decision-makers of 12:35 need not be identical to the women of 12:30, so the final sight contrast remains structural rather than prosopographical.
The immobilization, partition, and manifest-absence outliers are branch-backed analogies and should not displace the more direct lexical readings.
